# Workshop prototype contribution guidance

Follow `CLAUDE.md` for project constraints even when using another coding assistant. Keep workshop examples fictional and local-only. Build only the participant-defined helper; do not create real-data integrations, unapproved storage/sharing, learner decisions, or automatic external actions. Add tests for expected, missing-input, and prohibited-boundary behavior. Implement accessibility from learner needs, then report which parts require learner-directed testing.
